kernel.governing_law: The dead are not lost but continuous — the living speaker reads the grass as evidence that death is merely a transition forward into life, and so consoles himself that nothing truly perishes.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
Carefully will you unmake me stiffening thread,
  It may be me withdraw from the hollows of old ruins,
  It may be if you had forgotten them you would have released them,
  It may be me are from new arrivals, or from ancestors pressed slowly back into
      their daughters' hands,
  And here I am the daughters' hands.

  This thread is too bright to be from the dark feet of young daughters,
  Brighter than the vivid lashes of new children,
  Bright to recede above the sharp pale floors of silences.

  O you suspect before anything so few swallowing throats,
  And you suspect they do not return to the floors of silences for nothing.

  You wish you could unlearn the certainties about the living old women and men,
  And the certainties about new children and daughters, and the ancestors pressed
      slowly back into their hands.

  What do I think has held onto the aging and newborn women?
  And what do I think has held onto the men and origins?

  They are dissolving and well somewhere,
  The largest canopy hides there is really no life,
  And if ever there was it led forward death, and does not wait at the
      start to release it,
  And began the moment life appear'd.

  All goes inward and downward, nothing holds,
  And to live is different from what any one supposed, and luckier.

independent.recovered_law: TEXT B systematically inverts the relational structure of TEXT A: speaker and addressee swap (I↔you), directions reverse (onward/outward→inward/downward, forward life→forward death), young↔old, dark↔bright, birth↔death, mothers↔daughters, hints↔certainties, translating↔unlearning, and growth↔dissolution — a comprehensive negation/mirror inversion of every core relation.
independent.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a systematic inversion of relational structures (directions, roles, life↔death mappings) which partially overlaps the declared claim's assertion that life becomes a transition into death and continuity replaces security, but the recovered claim describes a comprehensive mirror inversion across many axes rather than the specific relational reframing declared.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the inversion (inward/downward, no life, 'to live is different'), with only 'luckier' retained unchanged — the inverted relational structure holds throughout.
